data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant claim reserved in Yen (Yen 686m); estimate reduced as Yen depreciated against sterling; reserved in Reinsurance to Close.
Reserve previously circa GBP 4.0m; claim settled at a lower amount (GBP 1.7m) resulting in a release relative to the prior reserve.
An additional loss was experienced which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.

prior_year_events.event_name: Possible material damage loss in China
prior_year_events.impact_description: A recent reserve of GBP 1.4m was established for a possible material damage loss in China.

named_events.loss_description: Reserved in line with estimates at a cost of Yen 686m; estimate reduced as Yen depreciated against sterling.
Reserve last year was some GBP 4m; claim settled at GBP 1.7m.
An additional loss was experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.
The Syndicate has established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 9.5m in 2014. The release reflects favourable claims development and low loss experience on prior underwriting years. Specific prior-year items discussed include a reserved claim on the Hamaoka nuclear plant (reserved in Yen 686m), the settlement of a medical isotope plant claim in South Africa for GBP 1.7m (reserve previously circa GBP 4.0m), an additional loss of GBP 1.5m at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK, and a new GBP 1.4m reserve for possible material damage in China.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).
The 2012 underwriting year has performed well, reflecting low loss experience and the decision not to buy reinsurance for the Syndicate.
This, coupled with other improvements, has resulted in a profit for the 2012 underwriting year of 62.4% of capacity.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (2013 column). Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a release of GBP 9.5m (assumed to be gross technical reserves). No gross claims development triangle was present in the provided pages. Some event amounts reported in foreign currency (Yen 686m) were not converted to GBP and thus left null. A number of event impacts are described in narrative (reserves, settlements and payments) and have been converted to signed GBP amounts where the text permits (settlement/payment vs prior reserve).
